card.name: Word starts before dose-related text
card.fires_on: Fires on the start of a new word or phrase, especially "Th" at the start of a name or sentence, or a word just before "doses" or "volume". Also fires on a bare space before a number.

modes.description: The letters "Th" begin a longer word or name, after a period, a title or a first name.

card.writes: It lowers the chance of the next word being dose, doses or dosage, and slightly raises a few unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires on word beginnings where a dose word might otherwise come next, and it holds that word back.
